_readme: Copy this file to shots.json (git-ignored) and point each entry at a model file.
file: .glb .gltf .fbx .obj or .blend; object: one object's name, or null for all of them (joined).
strokes: Stroke Count. stroke_size: optional, else the scene default (4).
brush: a shipped set (standard, rough, thin) or a folder of brush images. brushes: extra sets, rendered as brush_<set> shots.
view: camera direction from the model's centre, e.g. [-0.7, -1, -0.2] = front, a little left and below.
albedo: auto = the image feeding Principled Base Color; a path = that image; null = grey.
hero: true renders a before->after wipe in encode_hero.sh.
